svg.text: Atrial-region interventions: within-record logit change (modified - original), record-level 95% CI

Gain s scales the deviation of the atrial region (r-160..r-51) from its straight baseline: s=0 flatten, 0.5 attenuate, 1 unchanged, 1.5 / 2 amplify. QRS windows, RR intervals and all other samples are bit-identical.
